questions.q: A certain triangle has interior angle measures of $(6x)^\circ$, $(2x)^\circ$, and $x^\circ$. What is the value of $x$?
questions.explain: The sum of the interior angles of any triangle is always $180^\circ$. Therefore, set up the equation: $6x + 2x + x = 180$. Combining like terms gives $9x = 180$, which simplifies to $x = 20$.
questions.subject: Mathematics
